answer: Cross-attestation ledger linking. Each identity must anchor its actions to two prior identities, forming a directed history graph. When two nodes share an identical attestation ancestry, a duplicate ember signal fires and both accounts freeze pending audit. Honest agents diversify links naturally; a sybil cluster must fabricate distinct histories, paying per-identity compute to mine valid chains and risking onyx penalties on every link if one node is caught, exposing the whole cluster.
